passages.text: E101 belt not moving / conveyor will not start: record the visible E101 code and status indicator without opening any cover. Refer the recorded fault to the maintenance lead. Do not restart until the site-approved process authorizes it.

E202 conveyor vibration or rattling: stop use through the approved site procedure. Record the observed vibration and notify the maintenance lead. Internal inspection is reserved for qualified staff under the approved isolation procedure.

E303 conveyor overheating or high temperature: stop use through the approved site procedure and report the visible temperature and E303 code. Do not touch hot parts or open covers. Escalate to qualified maintenance.

E404 conveyor optical sensor alarm or sensor blocked: record the E404 fault and visible obstruction from outside the guarded area. Do not enter the guarded area, bypass the sensor or reset safety interlocks. Ask the maintenance lead to review the sensor procedure.
Previous E101 conveyor not moving event: a qualified maintenance lead reviewed the fault after isolation. Historical record only; this is not an instruction to repeat that repair.
Previous E202 vibration event: qualified staff recorded a loose bracket after isolation. This historical event does not establish the cause of the current fault.
Previous E303 overheating event: the team documented a cooling obstruction. This is a history record, not a diagnosis or an approved check for a new event.

Safety first: stop work if a hazard is suspected. Never bypass guards, sensors or interlocks. Do not reach into equipment. Internal work requires qualified supervision and the site-approved lockout/tagout and verification process. This demo does not authorize physical work.
Smoke, sparks, fire, burning smell, electric shock or exposed live wiring: keep clear and follow the site emergency procedure. Notify the safety lead. Do not attempt a repair from this application.

P10 pump low pressure or no flow: record the visible gauge reading and fault code from outside the restricted area. Stop use through the approved procedure and ask the maintenance lead to review the fault. Do not loosen pipes or open the pump.

Safety first: keep clear of pressurized systems and moving parts. Do not open pipes or pump housings. Qualified staff must follow the approved isolation and depressurization procedure. Escalate to the maintenance lead; this demo is not a work authorization.
